Root was a [[Nomai]] who worked in the [[Black Hole Forge]] along with [[Clary]] and [[Poke]] to create the [[Warp Core|warp cores]] that power the various warps throughout the Solar System, including the towers on [[Ash Twin]].<ref name=towers>ROOT: What if we used warp towers (like the one we have on the White Hole Station) to connect Ash Twin directly to each critical location? CLARY: Poke, Root, and I can begin work on this immediately in the Black Hole Forge (this will keep us busy!).</ref> 

==The Ash Twin Project==
Root was the one who proposed building the towers to connect Ash Twin to each location that was critical to the [[Ash Twin Project]]<ref name=towers/> He installed the warp cores and delivered them, but initially had difficulty figuring out where each one was supposed to go.<ref>CLARY: Here’s our first delivery, Yarrow: one warp core, fresh from the Black Hole Forge! Root is installing this core’s sibling on Brittle Hollow as I write this.</ref><ref>ROOT: Where am I taking this first black hole core? (And where am I taking the remaining cores once they’re ready?)</ref> He also tested [[Timber Hearth]] ore in [[Hollow's Lantern]] to see which one survived the longest in direct heat to seal off the Ash Twin Project.<ref>ROOT: Friends in the Timber Hearth Mines, the last type of ore you sent us survives the longest in direct heat. ROOT: My gratitude! I imagine we’ll also have an updated estimate soon of how much ore is needed to seal off the Ash Twin Project.</ref>

== Trivia ==

* Root is named after ''[[Wikipedia:Root|plant roots]]'', which serve to anchor the plant as well as provide water and nutrients.
